title: Triage Ticketly against WCAG 2.2 AA
prompt: A tester sent you six findings from Ticketly's checkout. Your team targets **WCAG 2.2 Level AA**. Select every finding that is a real AA (or A) failure and belongs in the bug tracker. Leave out anything that passes, or that only fails a AAA criterion.
hints: For each finding, name the success criterion first, then check its level in the quick reference.
Focus Appearance (2.4.13) is AAA. Target Size (Minimum) has an exception for links inside a sentence.
Four of the six are AA or A failures.
explanation: Four findings fail Level AA: the drag-only seat range (2.5.7 Dragging Movements), the banner that fully covers a focused button (2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured), the 16 px adjacent quantity buttons (2.5.8 Target Size), and the reverse-the-letters login challenge, a cognitive function test with no alternative (3.3.8 Accessible Authentication). The thin dotted focus ring is visible, so it passes 2.4.7 Focus Visible; the stricter 2.4.13 Focus Appearance is AAA. The small link inside the terms paragraph is covered by the inline exception in 2.5.8. Triage matters: a report that mixes AAA nice-to-haves with AA failures gets ignored.

seat-drag.text: Choosing a block of seats only works by dragging a selection rectangle across the seat map.
seat-drag.why: Fails 2.5.7 Dragging Movements (AA). Users need a single-pointer way, such as clicking seats one at a time.

focus-hidden.text: When you Tab to the "Checkout" button, the sticky cookie banner covers it completely.
focus-hidden.why: Fails 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA): the focused component is entirely hidden by author content.

tiny-qty.text: The ticket quantity "−" and "+" icon buttons are 16 × 16 px and touch each other.
tiny-qty.why: Fails 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA). They are under 24 × 24 px and have no spacing to compensate.

focus-thin.text: The focus ring is a 1 px dotted outline with good contrast against the background.
focus-thin.why: Passes AA. Focus is visible (2.4.7). Only 2.4.13 Focus Appearance, a AAA criterion, asks for a thicker indicator.

reverse-code.text: To sign in, users must type the letters of a displayed word in reverse order, with no other option.
reverse-code.why: Fails 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) (AA): it is a cognitive function test with no alternative or helper.

inline-link.text: A "refund policy" link inside a paragraph of terms is only 14 px tall.
inline-link.why: Passes. Targets inside a sentence or block of text are exempt from 2.5.8 under the inline exception.
